subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The council never _________ the new complex to be constructed, nor did local residents.
solution:
The correct answer is '**wanted**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**wanted**" is appropriate in the given context as it refers to having a desire for something. (चाहना)
 
• The council did not desire or approve the construction of the new complex, which aligns with the meaning of "wanted."
 
• The other options: "**occurred**," "**refreshed**," and "**liked**" do not fit the sentence as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The council never wanted__ the new complex to be constructed, nor did local residents.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Occurred (घटित)**: means to happen or take place, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Refreshed (स्फूर्ति देना)**: means to revive or renew energy, which is irrelevant here.
 
• **Liked (पसंद करना)**: means to enjoy or find agreeable, but it is not as appropriate as "wanted" in this context.
